description.en: DiCoBench evaluates multimodal LLMs on multi-image fine-grained perception using high-resolution (up to 2K) image pairs. It includes 765 multiple-choice questions across two tracks: differential and commonality visual cues, covering 8 perception tasks, with exact-match scoring.

claire_radar.whyItMatters: Existing benchmarks rely on explicit textual cues or low resolution, whereas DiCoBench targets autonomous discovery of subtle visual cues in high-resolution pairs. It provides a challenging testbed with a large human-model performance gap, aiding progress in complex multi-image understanding.
